title: Network Printer Troubleshooting Guide
problem: Employee is unable to print documents using the corporate printer.
prerequisites: Computer is connected to the corporate network.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check Printer Power
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Verify that the printer is powered on and there are no hardware error lights.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Printer Power Status

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Network Connection
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Ensure the printer and your computer are connected to the same corporate network.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Network Connection

troubleshooting_steps.title: Clear Print Queue
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Open the print queue and cancel any stuck print jobs before trying again.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Print Queue

troubleshooting_steps.title: Set Correct Default Printer
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Confirm that the correct printer is selected as the default printer.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Printer Settings

troubleshooting_steps.title: Print Test Page
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Print a Windows Test Page to verify printer communication.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Test Page

common_errors.resolution: Verify network connectivity and restart the printer.
Remove the jammed paper following the printer manufacturer's instructions.
Clear all pending print jobs and retry.

escalation.condition: Escalate if the printer remains unavailable after troubleshooting.

faq.question: Why is my printer showing Offline?
faq.answer: Usually because of a network issue, incorrect default printer, or the printer being powered off.

faq.question: Can I install my own printer driver?
faq.answer: Only approved printer drivers should be installed on corporate devices.
